name: Flola de Arcadare
original_name: フローラ・ド・アークアデア
source: The first princess of Arcadare. Flola is a very easygoing and friendly woman, the oldest of the sisters. She cares for Maria, Elena and Miria very much. She sometimes likes to tease her sisters, especially Maria, but receiving an aggressive response from her, feigns sadness in a fun way. Flola has also developed a complex for her big breasts because her "Tit Dance" is famous throughout the Universe for its peace-making effect on hostile ambassadors from different civilizations. Through, no body knows how much hard work is hidden behind her kind smile.
